These women looked after me like I was their CHILD when I had my bike stolen and sustained injuries outside their premises. Charged my phone, put a fan infront of me, let me call for help off their phones, cleaned and wrapped up my injuries..Incredibly kind. I was there for an hour and also noticed they make a big fuss of their furry clientele, welcoming them with treats & knowing them by name. Don’t hesitate. Your pet will be in good hands. 💕
